children: Kintsu said its official website was affected by a DNS hijacking incident involving its domain registrar and is displaying a malicious site. According to Odaily, the project warned users not to visit the site, connect their wallets, or sign transactions. Users who connected a wallet or signed a transaction since 00:00 UTC on October 31 should revoke related permissions through the Revoke platform and transfer their assets. Kintsu said it will issue another notice after confirming the website is secure.

title: Kintsu Confirms DNS Hijacking, Urges Users to Revoke Permissions and Move Assets
